description: Cancel the downtimes of a host or service, so it alerts again: a running one ends now, one that has not started is removed. Cancels every downtime on that object and says whose they were. Waits until they are gone.

hostname.description: Exact host name. Required - there is no estate-wide form of this tool. A name that matches no host is answered with the tools that can find the right one.

include_services.description: For a host: also cancel the downtimes of its services.

servicename.description: Exact service name on that host. Empty: the host's own downtimes.

name: cancel_downtime
title: Cancel Downtime
